title: Office NAS
hint.missing: Run bin/install of this plugin; it installs the service as root.
hint.notBtrfs: The backup snapshots btrfs subvolumes, and / is not on btrfs.
nas.away: The NAS is out of reach; backups wait for the office
toggle.on: Back up every hour the NAS is in reach
step.connection.todo: Needs "[Renuo-NAS] Backup User" from 1Password: server address, username and password. Connect at the office.
step.password.todo: Encrypts the backup; everyone at Renuo uses the same NAS login. Create one, or enter yours from 1Password on a new laptop.
step.password.done: Keep a copy in 1Password, in your Employee vault: without it nothing can be restored.
step.repository.todo: Create it on the NAS, or connect to the one your last laptop made. Needs the office network.
step.schedule.todo: Off. Switch them on at the top.
step.schedule.done: Every hour the NAS is in reach; next check %1
step.schedule.unknown: Every hour the NAS is in reach
